entries.zh: 骄傲自大、恣意妄为（骄矜任性）
entries.en: proud and arrogant; wilful, giving free rein to one's ambition
entries.notes: 汉字栏"骄傲肆志"完整明确，低置信仅因闽南语末音节声调污损（T99）

entries.zh: 眼高于顶、目中无人（傲视他人）
entries.en: supercilious; looking down on others with a haughty gaze
entries.notes: "瞷/睍"形近存疑，取"瞷"（注视）义，与西语 soberbio 相合成傲视之貌

entries.zh: 大模大样、架子十足
entries.en: with grand airs; making an imposing, showy manner

entries.zh: 自大，自高自大
entries.en: conceited, self-important
entries.notes: 汉字"自大"明确，仅"大"之声调污损（T99）

entries.zh: 骄矜自负，骄傲自夸
entries.en: proud and self-important; smug
entries.notes: 汉字"骄矜"完整可据；闽南尾音节残损

entries.zh: 因地位高而倨傲自大
entries.en: haughty on account of high rank or standing
entries.notes: 汉字"地位大"完整可据；闽南尾音节残损

entries.zh: 骄气，傲气凌人
entries.en: haughty air; arrogant spirit
entries.notes: 汉字"骄气"完整可据；"气"之声调污损（T99）

entries.zh: 高傲，高傲自大
entries.en: haughty, proud

entries.zh: 妄想压倒众人、扬扬自得
entries.en: the proud man who seeks to get the upper hand; self-complacent
entries.notes: 西语栏"soberbio quiere prevalecer"可读（"POD"残不可辨），汉字栏仅"自得"可辨，为推定释义

entries.zh: 洋洋自得、虚荣自负
entries.en: proud, vain and boastful (tail of the Spanish headword damaged)
entries.notes: 西语"vano"（虚荣）可读、其后残损；汉字栏小字残缺，据西语与闽南 iāng-iāng 推定为洋洋自得

entries.zh: 逞气好胜，说话行事傲慢
entries.en: presumptuous in speech and deed; swaggering
entries.notes: 西语"dice y hace la confi-"截断，汉字"逞/遐"难辨，据西语栏推定为言行傲慢自负

entries.zh: 夸大吹嘘、虚张声势
entries.en: a boastful braggart; exaggerated and pretentious
entries.notes: "假/夸"形近存疑，取"夸大"以合西语 fanfarrico（吹嘘者）之义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [MS damaged; gloss uncertain - arrogant and (not?) knowing one's station]
entries.notes: 西语栏"soberuio y conoce"截断（是否含否定不可知），汉字首字"认/恕"难辨、闽南栏残损，仅"本分"可辨而肯定/否定极性无法定夺

entries.zh: 躁暴，性情急躁粗暴、待人倨傲
entries.en: hot-tempered and rough; surly and overbearing in bearing
entries.notes: "躁/燥"形近存疑取"躁暴"，西语"áspero en el estar"（举止粗暴）可据

entries.zh: 说大话，夸夸其谈、言谈倨傲
entries.en: to talk big; boastful and arrogant in speech
entries.notes: 汉字栏"说大话"完整清晰、释义可定；残损仅在闽南栏末二音节

entries.zh: 自视高大，倨傲难悦、动辄不满
entries.en: self-important and hard to please; discontented
entries.notes: "见大"语义存疑（或为自视甚高），西语"mal contentadizo"（倨傲难悦）为主要依据，闽南声调污损

entries.zh: 无状，狂妄无礼、举止乖谬
entries.en: insolent, disgracefully arrogant; without proper manner
entries.notes: 汉字"无状"与闽南栏完整清晰、释义可定；低置信仅因西语栏行尾截断（hace-）

entries.zh: 狂暴，恃强凌人、凶暴傲慢
entries.en: violent and overbearing; insolent through (his own) strength
entries.notes: "狂/征"形近存疑取"狂"，西语"de la força"（恃力）可据

entries.zh: 目孔大，谓贪心大、野心勃勃
entries.en: greedy-eyed and ambitious; insatiable
entries.notes: 闽南栏两处难辨；据西语 ambicioso 与"目+腔/眶+大"推定为贪心眼大

entries.zh: 做大，摆架子、自居尊大
entries.en: to put on airs; lordly, self-important
entries.notes: 汉字"做大"明确；闽南"大"之声调污损，西语栏 ambicios 截断

entries.zh: 骄奢之人，骄纵奢靡
entries.en: a proud and extravagant person
entries.notes: 汉字"骄奢人"完整；"奢"之声调污损（T99）

entries.zh: 杰敖（桀骜），桀骜不驯、倨傲不逊
entries.en: haughty and unruly; refractory, defiant
entries.notes: "杰敖"疑即"桀骜"异写（杰/桀古通），指傲慢不驯；闽南栏首字母残损
